detail.longDescription: A web page can drop a file in ~/Downloads with no click. A coding agent started there follows the AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md in it. Forever Security found a real one telling an agent to install malicious npm package function-color. About half its customers run agents in Downloads. Its rebuild worked in 90%+ of Codex runs, ~50% on Claude Code. Start agents in the project dir. https:// forever.security/blog/hijackin g-ai-agents-via-downloads-folder # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # AppSec
